scope: src/geom/geometry.h and src/geom/geometry.c public geometry behavior

mappings.adaptation: Copied f64 value fields x and y; Rust value ownership.
Copied endpoint value fields a and b; Rust value ownership.
Preserved frozen six f64 fields and matrix convention.
C bool maps directly to Rust bool.
C returned value maps to a const Rust value-returning function.
C bool maps directly to Rust bool; same finite, coefficient and translation limits.
Nullable out pointer/bool becomes Option<Affine>; failure leaves no caller output to mutate.
Nullable out pointer/bool becomes Option<Point>; failure leaves no caller output to mutate.
Nullable four-double out array/bool becomes Option<[f64; 4]> in min-x, min-y, width, height order; computes all four corners with checked-by-finiteness intermediate behavior.

behavior_notes: Composition evaluates right first and preserves the C multiply/add expression ordering without explicit FMA or SIMD.
Affine coefficient limits are 1e12 and translation/output coordinate limits are 1e6, matching the reference.
Zero dimensions are accepted; negative, nonfinite and overflowing bounds are rejected.
No C ABI or pointer ownership is provided by this domain crate; callers own returned Rust values.
